claim: Под руководством Medivh Thrall и Jaina отложили вражду.
quote: Under Medivh’s guidance, Thrall and Jaina Proudmoore – the leader of the human forces in Kalimdor – realized that they had to put aside their differences.

claim: Ночные эльфы во главе с Malfurion и Tyrande решили объединиться ради Мирового древа.
quote: Similarly, the night elves, led by Malfurion and Tyrande, agreed that they must unite if they hoped to defend the World Tree.

claim: Archimonde шёл уничтожить Nordrassil.
quote: Under orders from Kil’jaeden himself, Archimonde and his demons followed the undead Scourge to Kalimdor, bent on destroying Nordrassil, the World Tree.

claim: Jaina и Thrall сдерживали Legion, пока друиды готовили последнюю защиту.
quote: Setting aside their differences, Jaina and Thrall worked together to delay the Legion's advance while night elf druids prepared one last defense: a powerful explosion of magic that destroyed most of the Legion's forces on Kalimdor.

claim: Malfurion высвободил ярость Nordrassil и уничтожил Archimonde.
quote: Empowered by the very strength of the world, Malfurion succeeded in unleashing Nordrassil’s primal fury, utterly destroying Archimonde and severing the Legion’s anchor to the Well of Eternity.

claim: Лишённый силы Well, Legion рухнул.
quote: Unable to draw power from the Well itself, the Burning Legion crumbled under the combined might of the mortal armies.

claim: Ночные эльфы пожертвовали бессмертием.
quote: Though victorious, the night elves were forced to sacrifice their cherished immortality and watch their beloved forests burn.

claim: Дух Malfurion затерялся в Emerald Dream.
quote: Shortly thereafter, Malfurion’s spirit was somehow lost within the depths of the Emerald Dream.

claim: Fandral Staghelm стал новым Arch-Druid.
quote: With Malfurion missing, Fandral Staghelm – the leader of those who wished to plant the new World Tree – became the new Arch-Druid.

claim: Друиды посадили Teldrassil у северных берегов Kalimdor.
quote: he and his fellow druids had forged ahead and planted the great tree, Teldrassil, off the stormy coasts of northern Kalimdor.

claim: В ветвях Teldrassil вырос город Darnassus.
quote: Among the twilight boughs of the colossal tree, the wondrous city of Darnassus took root.

claim: Древо не получило благословения природы и поддалось порче.
quote: However, the tree was not consecrated with nature’s blessing and soon fell prey to the corruption of the Burning Legion.

claim: Tyrande освободила Illidan после десяти тысяч лет заключения.
quote: During the Legion’s invasion of Ashenvale, Tyrande released Illidan from his barrow prison, where he had spent ten thousand years of captivity.

claim: Kil’jaeden приказал Illidan уничтожить Ner’zhul.
quote: Kil’jaeden ordered Illidan to destroy Ner’zhul and put an end to the undead Scourge once and for all.

claim: Половина нежити во главе с Sylvanas подняла мятеж.
quote: Half of the standing undead forces, led by the banshee Sylvanas Windrunner, staged a coup for control over the undead empire.

claim: Sylvanas и Forsaken заняли разрушенную столицу Lordaeron.
quote: Ultimately Sylvanas and her rebel undead (known as the Forsaken) claimed the ruined capital city of Lordaeron as their own.

claim: Forsaken построили оплот под руинами и поклялись изгнать Scourge.
quote: Constructing their own bastion, far beneath the wrecked city, the Forsaken vowed to defeat the Scourge and drive Kel’Thuzad and his minions from the land.

claim: Arthas опередил Illidan и первым достиг Frozen Throne.
quote: Even weakened as he was, Arthas outmaneuvered Illidan and reached the Frozen Throne first.

claim: Духи Ner’zhul и Arthas слились в одно существо.
quote: Arthas placed the unimaginably powerful helm on his head, and Ner’zhul and Arthas’ spirits fused into a single mighty being, as Ner’zhul had planned all along.

claim: Arthas — новый бессмертный Lich King в Northrend.
quote: Currently Arthas, the new and immortal Lich King, resides in Northrend

claim: Kel’Thuzad командует Scourge в Plaguelands; Forsaken держат только Tirisfal.
quote: His trusted lieutenant, Kel’Thuzad, commands the Scourge in the Plaguelands. Sylvanas and her rebel Forsaken hold only the Tirisfal Glades

claim: Народы начали новую жизнь с шаткого перемирия Alliance и Horde.
quote: The war had wounded each race deeply, but they had selflessly banded together to attempt a new beginning, starting with the uneasy truce between the Alliance and Horde.

claim: Мануал 2004 года: вторжение Legion случилось четыре года назад.
quote: The Legion meticulously planned its return to the mortal world over the course of many long centuries. Four years ago, their grand design came to fruition at last.

claim: Stormwind правит ребёнок-король Anduin Wrynn.
quote: The child-king Anduin Wrynn rules the people of Stormwind, who remain steadfast in their commitment to the Grand Alliance.

claim: Армии Stormwind снова воюют с Horde на далёких полях.
quote: Backed by their stalwart allies, the armies of Stormwind have been called away to once again fight the savage Horde on distant battlefields.

claim: Stormwind отстроен после Second War.
quote: Rebuilt after the Second War, Stormwind is a marvel of human design and engineering.

claim: Король Varian Wrynn пропал по пути на встречу в Theramore.
quote: Recently his father, King Varian Wrynn, went missing under suspicious circumstances while en route to a diplomatic summit at Theramore Isle.

claim: По приказу Mekkatorque gnomes выпустили радиацию в Gnomeregan.
quote: At the command of the High Tinker Mekkatorque, the gnomes opened the pressure valves of their giant, grinding machines and released toxic radiation throughout the city.

claim: Радиация убила почти восемьдесят процентов gnomes.
quote: Though the radiation killed the troggs, the gnomes soon discovered that it killed their own people just as quickly. Nearly eighty percent of the gnomish race died within days.

claim: Выжившие gnomes бежали в Ironforge.
quote: Those that survived evacuated the great city and fled to the protection of their dwarven cousins in Ironforge.

claim: Forsaken Kingdom заполняет четырёхлетний разрыв между Warcraft III и WoW.
quote: Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom explores the events between Arthas's return to Lordaeron and the emergence of the Undercity, filling in the four-year gap between Warcraft III and World of Warcraft.

claim: Forsaken Kingdom уже доступна.
quote: Forsaken Kingdom is available today. Players can also see Definitive Edition Graphics and the Forsaken Paladin in action during the Classic Cup.

claim: Forever продолжается вскоре после событий Forsaken Kingdom.
quote: World of Warcraft: Forever continues shortly after the events of the Forsaken Kingdom campaign, inviting players to carve a new path through a reimagined original Azeroth when it launches on November 4, 2026.

claim: Forever — новый постоянный дом рядом с modern и Classic WoW.
quote: Built as a new permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW, Forever invites past, current, and new players into a familiar yet fresh Azeroth where the world takes center stage, community comes first, and the journey matters as much as the destination.

claim: Hyjal в Forever — последствия поражения Archimonde и Darkwhisper Gorge.
quote: Mount Hyjal invites you to explore the aftermath of Archimonde’s defeat, journey through Darkwhisper Gorge, and help shape the future of a recovering land.

claim: Riverglades — зона середины пути, размером со Stranglethorn Vale.
quote: toward the Riverglades: a mid-level zone roughly the size of Stranglethorn Vale, built from a previously inaccessible part of the Classic world

claim: Zephras Isle — стартовая зона Skyborne для уровней 1–12.
quote: On Zephras Isle, you’ll begin an elemental skybound starting experience from levels 1 through 12, blending Classic Warcraft aesthetics with architecture inspired by Skywall.

claim: Объявлены Barrow Deeps на 10 игроков и Hyjal Summit на 20.
quote: The Barrow Deeps is planned as a maximum-level 10-player challenge, while Hyjal Summit will bring 20-player raid encounters to one of Warcraft’s most important locations.

claim: Запуск 4 ноября 2026, бета с 17 сентября, новые рейды откроются 9 декабря.
quote: World of Warcraft: Forever launches globally on November 4, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. PST, with beta beginning September 17. New raids unlock on December 9, followed by more raids, dungeons, PvP updates, world content, additional quests throughout the level 1–60 journey.

claim: Многие ночные эльфы не смогли смириться со старением и болезнями.
quote: there were many night elves who could not adjust to the prospects of aging, disease, and frailty.

claim: Kil’jaeden чувствовал, что его создание, Lich King, выходит из-под контроля.
quote: Sensing that his creation, the Lich King, was growing too powerful to control

claim: Frozen Throne — ледяной кристалл, где заключён дух Lich King.
quote: Illidan agreed and immediately set out to destroy the Frozen Throne, the icy crystal cask in which the Lich King’s spirit resided.

claim: Когда сила Lich King слабела, слабел и Arthas.
quote: As the Lich King's strength waned, so too did Arthas' powers.

claim: Ослабленный Arthas поспешил в Northrend спасать господина.
quote: Weakened, but determined to save his master, Arthas reached Northrend only to find Illidan’s naga and blood elves waiting for him.

claim: Frostmourne Arthas разбил ледяную темницу Lich King.
quote: Using his runeblade, Frostmourne, Arthas shattered the Lich King’s icy prison and thereby released Ner’zhul’s enchanted helm and breastplate.

claim: Stormwind — один из последних оплотов людей.
quote: Stormwind City is one of the last bastions of human power in the world.

claim: Troggs вырвались из-под Gnomeregan и начали истреблять gnomes.
quote: The troggs – believed to have been unearthed from the Uldaman excavation – erupted beneath Gnomeregan and began to slaughter every gnome within the city.

claim: С Eye of Sargeras Illidan отправился в Dalaran.
quote: With the powerful Eye in his possession, Illidan traveled to the former wizard-city of Dalaran.

claim: Illidan обрушил разрушительное заклинание на Icecrown.
quote: Illidan used the Eye to cast a destructive spell against the Lich King’s citadel of Icecrown in distant Northrend.

claim: Заклинание остановили Malfurion и Tyrande, пришедшие на помощь Maiev.
quote: At the final moment, Illidan’s destructive spell was stopped when his brother Malfurion and the Priestess Tyrande arrived to aid Maiev.

claim: Maiev была тюремщицей Illidan десять тысяч лет.
quote: Maiev had been Illidan's jailor for ten thousand years and relished the prospect of recapturing him.

claim: Illidan бежал обратно в Outland.
quote: Illidan and his troops were forced to flee back to Outland in disgrace

claim: Illidan обошёл Maiev и добыл Eye of Sargeras.
quote: Nevertheless, Illidan outsmarted Maiev and her Watchers and succeeded in claiming the Eye of Sargeras despite their efforts.

claim: Kil’jaeden был разгневан поражением Archimonde, но тревожился о большем.
quote: Kil’jaeden was angered by Archimonde’s defeat at Mount Hyjal, but he had bigger concerns than vengeance.
